guide.betterfishtanks.intro.title:
Welcome to
Better Fishtanks
guide.betterfishtanks.intro.text: This mod allows you to create beautiful aquariums and manage your own aquatic ecosystem.
guide.betterfishtanks.fishtank.title: Fish Tank
guide.betterfishtanks.fishtank.text: The Fish Tank is the core of this mod. It can hold water, lava, decorations, and fish. U can use a bucket, or pipes from other mods to fill it.
guide.betterfishtanks.fishbag.title: Fish Bag
guide.betterfishtanks.fishbag.text: The Fish Bag allows you to transport fish safely. Right-click a fish to catch it, and shift-right-click to release it.
guide.betterfishtanks.aquarist_table.tex: The Aquarist Table is used to craft decorations and fish food. It's essential for maintaining a healthy tank.
guide.betterfishtanks.config.title: Configuration
guide.betterfishtanks.config.creative_on: Configuration options are only available in Creative Mode.
guide.betterfishtanks.fisheggs.title: Fish Eggs
guide.betterfishtanks.fisheggs.text: Fish in tanks will occasionally lay eggs if they are well-fed. These eggs can be used for trading or cracked in the Aquarist's Table to obtain resources.
guide.betterfishtanks.food.title: Fish Food
guide.betterfishtanks.food.text: Fish need food to survive and reproduce. You can craft various types of food like Flakes and Pellets at the Aquarist Table.
guide.betterfishtanks.randomfishbag.text: Obtainable from the Aquarist Villager. Contains a surprise fish! Shift-right-click to open and reveal your new aquatic friend.
guide.betterfishtanks.decorations.title: Decorations
guide.betterfishtanks.decorations.text: Decorations can be crafted at the Aquarist Table. They make your tank look great and provide shelter for your fish.
